changed_in.5.2: Rejects a `0x` prefix when `base` is 16, and reads an explicit `base` of 10 as a digit scan like every other base; 5.1 answers 255 for `tonumber("0xff", 16)`, and reads `tonumber("3.5", 10)` as an ordinary Lua numeral and answers 3.5.
changed_in.5.3: Requires `e` to be a string when `base` is given, and requires `base` to hold an exact whole number; 5.1 and 5.2 read a number `e` as its own digits, and truncate a `base` that carries a fraction.
